info.name: Adobe Photoshop Get PSD Service Job Status

params.name: jobId
params.description: The unique job identifier returned when the job was created.

items.docs: Polls the status of an asynchronous PSD service job. Returns the current status (pending, running, succeeded, failed) along with output details upon completion.

info.name: Adobe Photoshop Get Sensei Service Job Status

params.name: jobId
params.description: The unique job identifier returned when the job was created.

items.docs: Polls the status of an asynchronous Sensei AI service job such as background removal or mask creation.
